about: The starting weights of the shorts picker's scoring model (learn.js). Every church starts here; its own review actions move it. tools/tune-shorts.mjs fits them on free-to-use recordings (docs/SHORTS.md lists them); the recordings themselves are not kept.

labels.response: moments the room answers (applause, amen, laughter)
labels.pause: lines that end on a pause
labels.strong: lines about God, grace and hope
labels.you: lines that speak straight to the listener
labels.question: questions to the listener
labels.ai: the moments the AI rates highly
labels.peak: the loudest part of a song
labels.lenDev: shorts close to its usual length
